label: G T2b High base-vs-arm
brief: Fixed captures from the game of the trainer swimming in a Tidewake sea current, seen from the normal third-person swimming camera (three views: day, day, night). Judge whether the current's direction and strength read at a glance on a 7-inch handheld screen while swimming, and whether the water reads as the key art's world.
defects: The swimming current's direction cannot be read from the swimmer view at a glance on a 7-inch screen
Live currents use long bright evenly spaced parallel white streaks that read like guide lanes on the water surface
